mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation (uuid, demand_uuid, engagement_uuid, owner_id, participant_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{uuid}, #{demandUuid}, #{engagement_uuid}, #{ownerId}, #{participantId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET demand_uuid = #{demandUuid}, engagement_uuid = #{engagement_uuid}, owner_id = #{ownerId}, participant_id = #{participantId}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE uuid = #{uuid}
UPDATE conversation SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{uuid}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM conversation ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT * FROM conversation WHERE demand_uuid = #{demand_uuid} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT * FROM conversation WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT * FROM conversation WHERE participant_id = #{participantId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT c.uuid, c.demand_uuid, d.title AS demand_title, c.owner_id, COALESCE(owner_detail.nickname, owner_user.username, c.owner_id) AS owner_name, c.participant_id, COALESCE(participant_detail.nickname, participant_user.username, c.participant_id) AS participant_name, c.status, last_msg.message AS last_message, last_msg.time AS last_message_time, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM conversation c LEFT JOIN demand d ON c.demand_uuid = d.uuid LEFT JOIN `user` owner_user ON c.owner_id = owner_user.uuid LEFT JOIN user_detail owner_detail ON c.owner_id = owner_detail.user_uuid LEFT JOIN `user` participant_user ON c.participant_id = participant_user.uuid LEFT JOIN user_detail participant_detail ON c.participant_id = participant_detail.user_uuid LEFT JOIN chat_message last_msg ON last_msg.id = ( SELECT cm.id FROM chat_message cm WHERE cm.conversation_uuid = c.uuid ORDER BY cm.time DESC, cm.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE c.owner_id = #{userId} OR c.participant_id = #{userId} ORDER BY COALESCE(last_msg.time, c.updated_at) DESC
SELECT * FROM conversation WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (conversation_uuid, user_uuid, message, time, is_img, is_read) VALUES (#{conversation_uuid}, #{user_uuid}, #{message}, #{time}, #{img}, #{read})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM conversation WHERE demand_uuid = #{demandUuid} AND ((owner_id = #{userA} AND participant_id = #{userB}) OR (owner_id = #{userB} AND participant_id = #{userA})) LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{uuid}
